record: AlphaGenome / AlphaGenome Atlas access audit for Sprint 5
checked_by: research subagent (web + source-code inspection; no account, no key, no terms accepted)
blocker: Track/tissue-level AlphaGenome Atlas scores ('Raw Atlas Features') are API-only; the API requires an API key (gRPC header x-goog-api-key to dns:///gdmscience.googleapis.com:443). The web portal requires Google sign-in. Official static downloads (AVI, merged splicing, AVI SHAP) returned HTTP 500 to unauthenticated requests and a third-party mirror states the source is behind a sign-in.
user_action_one_line: Sign in at https://deepmind.google.com/science/alphagenome/api, accept the AlphaGenome Terms (non-commercial), create a free API key, then run: ALPHAGENOME_API_KEY=<key> python pipelines/sprint5/alphagenome_query.py --variants data/sprint5/query_variants_cognition.csv (needs pip install 'alphagenome>=0.9.0').

authentication: API key required for both live model (dna_client.create(api_key)) and Atlas (atlas.create(api_key)); key obtained at https://deepmind.google.com/science/alphagenome/api after Google sign-in. Web portal: 'Sign in and explore'.
usage_limits: Free for non-commercial use; 'Query rates vary based on demand'; live predictions suited to 1000s of predictions, 'likely not suitable for large scale analyses requiring more than 1 million predictions'; Atlas precomputed queries 'will typically have a larger query rate'. No numeric quota published.

terms.summary: Outputs and Atlas information are non-commercial only (except Permissive Use Downloadable Artifacts, i.e. the AVI SNV score download); must not be used to train variant-effect ML models; research only, not for clinical decisions; redistribution must carry the Output Terms notice. Commercial access via Google Cloud Model Garden.
terms.model_weights: https://github.com/google-deepmind/alphagenome_research ; weights on Kaggle (https://www.kaggle.com/models/google/alphagenome) and Hugging Face (google/alphagenome-all-folds: gated='auto', i.e. login + terms acceptance) under separate model terms https://deepmind.google.com/science/alphagenome/model-terms

genome_build: GRCh38/hg38 (GRCh38.p13) with GENCODE v46 annotations for the Atlas; mouse mm10. hg19 not supported (liftover required).

variant_input_schema.atlas_key: chr:pos:ref>alt with REF implicit from GRCh38; swapping REF/ALT (e.g. by minor allele) gives a lookup miss; no non-ref-to-non-ref substitutions; N bases unscored.
variant_input_schema.atlas_coverage: all ~9 billion possible SNVs on hg38 (8,812,917,339 scored per mirror manifests); indels observed in gnomAD/UKB/All of Us (>100M) scored in the research release but the Data Availability section says downloads are 'currently limited to all valid genome-wide SNVs'.

recommended_variant_scorers.RNA_SEQ: gene exon mask; log(mean(ALT)+0.001) - log(mean(REF)+0.001) per gene x track (signed)
recommended_variant_scorers.POLYADENYLATION: 400-bp windows at PAS; max |log fold change| of distal/proximal isoform ratio (unsigned)
recommended_variant_scorers.SPLICE_JUNCTIONS: top-k splice sites of gene; max |log(ALT) - log(REF)| of junction counts (unsigned)
recommended_variant_scorers.CONTACT_MAPS: 1 Mb window; mean |ALT - REF| contact frequency for the variant bin (unsigned)
recommended_variant_scorers.ACTIVE_ALLELE: max(agg(ALT), agg(REF)) for RNA_SEQ, CAGE, PROCAP, DNASE, ATAC, CHIP_TF, CHIP_HISTONE
recommended_variant_scorers.quantile_score: rank of raw score within a per-scorer x per-track background of ~300k common variants (MAF>0.01 in any gnomAD v3 population); signed scorers mapped to [-1,1]; capped at +/-0.99999; only for recommended scorers. Docs: use quantile to flag 'unusually large', raw score for magnitude.

AVI_definition.name: AlphaGenome Variant Impact (AVI) score
AVI_definition.definition: Neural network (encoder + hypernetwork producing non-negative per-feature weights + linear component) over 18 features: 10 AlphaGenome modality features (DNase, ATAC, ChIP-TF, ChIP-histone, CAGE, PRO-cap, RNA-seq, polyadenylation, splicing, contact maps), each the per-variant MAXIMUM predicted effect across tissues/tracks; 4 coding features (AlphaMissense; VEP stop_gained-or-frameshift, start_lost, stop_lost); 2 conservation features (PhastCons 470-way, Zoonomia Cactus 241-way); 2 indel indicators. Trained on gnomAD v4.1 genomes to discriminate proxy-impactful (FAF95_GRPMAX < 0.001) from proxy-neutral (0.001 <= FAF95_GRPMAX < 0.999) variants, trinucleotide-context balanced, 10 resampled training sets. Output: raw logit and PHRED = genome-wide rank of raw score among all hg38 SNVs (PHRED 10 = top 10%, 20 = top 1%); indel PHRED via the SNV quantile curve. Feature attributions: expected-gradients SHAP per feature; the 18 SHAP values sum to the raw AVI score (reference = all-zero input).
AVI_definition.source: Cheng et al. 2026, AlphaGenome Atlas preprint PDF, Fig. 1 legend and Methods ('AlphaGenome Variant Impact Scores'); https://storage.googleapis.com/deepmind-media/DeepMind.com/Blog/alphagenome-atlas-a-predictive-map-of-every-possible-dna-letter-change-in-the-human-genome/alphagenome-atlas.pdf (sha256 07011853872613cb7bd3ce8ca62cd2621ad50b0a16e6f5dec3e480b3d190af2c, 14,647,436 bytes, last-modified 2026-09-08)
AVI_definition.caveat_for_this_project: AVI is trained to separate rare from common variants and takes the max across ALL tissues; common GWAS credible-set SNPs (MAF ~0.05-0.5) are expected to sit in low AVI ranges by construction and AVI carries no tissue or direction information. Brain-track raw/quantile scores, not AVI, are the relevant quantity for cognition loci. AVI model code/weights 'will be provided upon final publication'.

feature_attribution_and_ISM: Live API: DnaClient.score_ism_variants(interval, ism_interval, variant_scorers) and alphagenome.interpretation.ism (ISM matrices; ALT-allele ISM since 0.5.0). Atlas: precomputed ISM-derived motif maps (>2,500 motifs) and 'Active ISM' contributions shown in the portal; motif bulk download 'soon'. AVI SHAP attributions downloadable (non-commercial, 283.9 GB) or via API.

brain_neural_coverage.absent: No brain ATAC (ATAC is mostly cell-type/immune), no brain PRO-cap (12 cell-line tracks), no brain contact maps (28 cell-line maps), no single-cell brain types beyond those listed (no microglia, no GABAergic interneuron term).
brain_neural_coverage.uncertainty: This is the live-model track list. The Atlas scorer/track list (ListVariantScoresMetadata) needs an API key and could not be inspected; the paper says Atlas scores come from the distilled model with the default scorers, so the same biosamples are expected but not verified.
